about: Extended qual set for the model benchmark (MODELS-PLAN.md section 3): answers as KPI gets them (a transcript or a typed answer), each with KoboToolbox analysis questions and their expected answers, written by hand. Questions are in English, as on most projects. Each answer is hard on purpose in a way noted in 'why'. 'review' marks text a native speaker should check before scores are published. Hausa and Amharic answers are still to be written by native speakers (FLEURS covers their transcription and translation). Choice indexes count from 0; qualText passes when the answer has a word from each group in expect_words. A qualText answer may quote the respondent's own language (KPI's prompt doesn't say which language to answer in), so expect_words include the source-language words too.

answers.why: two speakers who disagree; the respondent's view is the one asked for
answers.text: Interviewer: How many people live in this household? Respondent: Seven, with my mother. My husband says eight because his brother stays with us sometimes, but he is not here most of the year. Interviewer: And your main problem now? Respondent: Water. The tap stand has been dry since the rains stopped. My husband thinks food is worse, but for me it is water, because we buy it from the truck and it costs more every week.
